findings.oracle: Real OpenAIProvider.connect against live api.openai.com/models with a bogus sk- key; oracle = OpenAI's HTTP 401; asserts message startswith 'Invalid OpenAI API key:', chained __cause__ is openai.AuthenticationError with status_code==401, and provider left is_connected False with client None.

Real OpenAIProvider.connect with ProviderCredentials(api_key=''); oracle = production constant 'OpenAI API key is required'; asserts exact message equality plus provider.client is None and is_connected False, proving the local guard ran before any network call (companion None-key boundary test added).

Fresh OpenAIProvider; asserts is_connected False and client None first, then list_models raises ProviderError with exact 'Not connected to OpenAI API' message and the flag stays False, proving the not-connected guard fired.

Real connect with configured key (live /models round-trip) then disconnect; asserts provider.client becomes None and a subsequent list_models raises ProviderError 'Not connected to OpenAI API', proving real teardown not just a flag flip.

No monkeypatch: a second sqlite3 connection holds BEGIN EXCLUSIVE so real store.save raises OperationalError 'database is locked'; after releasing the lock, condition-polls manager.get until the sentinel tag persists and asserts is_auto_saving stays True; deleting the loop's broad guard kills the task so sentinel never persists -> RED.

Eight distinct sessions with unique tags+tool states updated concurrently via asyncio.gather against a real instrumented SessionStore; asserts max_concurrent_saves==1 AND reloads each from SQLite asserting id/name/tags/tool_state.connected/process_attached/target_path field-by-field, catching partial or corrupt writes.

Both hasattr smoke tests deleted (consolidated): replaced by existing real round-trip gates test_set_tool_state_round_trips_through_store, test_set_tool_state_overwrites_previous_entry, test_add_tag_round_trip_through_store, and test_remove_tag_persists which call the writers and assert SQLite save/load values.

AST declarative-body check retained but paired with real runtime contract tests: a live intellicrack_hexcore.HexDocument-backed adapter must satisfy runtime_checkable HexDocumentFull, a read-only doc must NOT, and TemplateManager.bootstrap_builtins (typed HexDocumentFull) drives the real document end-to-end asserting exported JSON equals the document's own export_template_json.
